meta.name: founder-os-setup
meta.description: Set up Founder OS from scratch, or adopt it into an existing notes folder. Fires on any natural-language onboarding ask, including: "set up Founder OS", "set up my second brain", "help me set up my second brain", "help me onboard", "onboard me", "what do I do", "where do I start", "how does this work", "I'm new", "get me started", "run the setup wizard", "install Founder OS" - and the adopt path: "I already have notes", "I already have an Obsidian vault", "set up inside my vault", "adopt my existing notes" (or run /founder-os:setup). Walks the operator through identity, tool stack, work style, brain system, cadence, roles, and the first project as an interactive wizard - it adapts to your role, founder or employee, rather than assuming you own the company. Pass "reset" to reconfigure an existing setup.
